comments.content: The rename logic frees `cmd->current_name` when it differs from `cmd->fullname`, but it does not remove the command from `server.commands` under its old name before adding it under the new name. Since `server.commands` is now hashed by `current_name`, the old name remains in the hashtable pointing to the same command, and `hashtableAdd` will insert a second entry under the new name. This leaves a stale entry under the old name, so the old name still resolves to the command (and `hashtableAdd` may fail if the new name already exists). The command must be removed from `server.commands` using the old `current_name` before updating `current_name` and re-adding it.
